name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Riyadh attacked 8 Nov; coalition hits Sanaa
summary: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed a Houthi launcher in Sanaa on 8 Nov after missiles targeted Riyadh
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile launch platform in Sanaa on 8 Nov, after intercepting two ballistic and two cruise missiles aimed at Riyadh and the south (Khaleej Times). Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry said debris damaged an Aramco administrative building in Riyadh, with no casualties (CNN), and witnesses reported damage to a tower in the King Abdullah Financial District (Malay Mail). The Houthi-run health ministry said strikes near Sanaa killed 33 people, a figure not independently confirmed.
for_you: FCDO travel advice is the official guide for Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and neighbouring states. Airspace and airport closures can follow attacks at short notice.
